title: Do Not Answer
genre: AI / 科技懸疑 / 心理驚悚
hook: AI 可以預測明天誰會死亡，但從來不告訴他原因。

lead.label: 男主（AI 工程師）
lead.description: an Asian male AI engineer in his early 30s, short black hair, thin glasses, lean build, dark casual shirt, slightly tired appearance, intelligent but anxious expression

chen.label: 陳先生（劇本未給外觀，此為補充設定，請確認）
chen.description: an Asian man in his late 50s, short grey hair, kind tired face, beige windbreaker over a light blue shirt

scenes.title: 螢幕顯示陳先生將於明天 09:13 死亡
scenes.beat_zh: 深夜。AI 工程師坐在現代家庭辦公室。電腦螢幕顯示：陳先生將於明天 09:13 死亡。
scenes.action: The engineer sits at his desk late at night, leaning slightly toward a large computer monitor, his face lit by the screen, reading a short message on it with a stunned, anxious expression.
scenes.setting: modern home office, a desk with two monitors and a keyboard, a bookshelf with books and a small plant, a window showing distant city lights
scenes.lighting: cool monitor glow on his face and glasses, a warm desk lamp on the desk, soft city light from the window, bookshelf and room details readable
scenes.on_screen_text: the large monitor shows a single line of white text on a dark interface: "陳先生將於明天 09:13 死亡"

compositions.A: medium shot from the side, the engineer at the right, the monitor with its text facing the camera at the left, the office around them
compositions.B: over-the-shoulder shot from behind the engineer, the monitor and its message filling the centre of the frame, his tense profile at the edge

scenes.title: 你怎麼知道？因為你問過我
scenes.beat_zh: 男主問 AI：你怎麼知道？AI：因為你問過我。畫面顯示：CONVERSATION NOT FOUND。
scenes.action: The engineer leans forward with both hands on the keyboard, staring at the screen in confusion and rising fear.
scenes.setting: the same modern home office, two monitors, keyboard, bookshelf, window with city lights
scenes.lighting: cool monitor glow on his face and glasses, warm desk lamp, soft city light, room details readable
scenes.on_screen_text: the monitor shows a bold red error message on a dark interface: "CONVERSATION NOT FOUND"

compositions.A: medium shot from the front-left, the engineer leaning toward the monitor, the red error text readable on the screen beside him
compositions.B: close-up of the monitor with the red error text, the engineer's worried face and glasses reflecting the screen in the foreground

scenes.title: 隔天，男主阻止陳先生出門
scenes.beat_zh: 隔天。男主衝到陳先生家。阻止他出門。
scenes.action: Early in the morning the engineer stands in an apartment doorway, out of breath, gripping the arm of Mr. Chen to stop him from leaving; Mr. Chen looks bewildered, his briefcase in his other hand.
scenes.setting: an ordinary apartment entrance, a shoe cabinet, a coat hook, an open front door with a bright corridor behind
scenes.lighting: bright morning daylight from the corridor window, a warm hallway lamp, clear detail

compositions.A: medium shot from inside the apartment, both men in the doorway, the engineer at the left holding Mr. Chen's arm
compositions.B: close two-shot of the engineer's desperate face and Mr. Chen's puzzled face, hands on the arm in the lower frame

scenes.title: 09:13，什麼都沒有發生
scenes.beat_zh: 09:13。什麼都沒有發生。男主以為自己成功阻止死亡。AI：預測修正。
scenes.action: Inside the apartment living room the engineer exhales in relief with a tired smile, one hand on the back of a chair, while Mr. Chen sits at the table with a cup of tea, puzzled but unharmed. An analog wall clock on the wall behind them is clearly visible.
scenes.setting: a tidy apartment living room, a dining table with a teapot and cups, a sofa, a wall clock
scenes.lighting: soft morning daylight through a window, warm and calm, every detail readable

compositions.A: wide medium shot of the room, the wall clock at the upper centre, Mr. Chen seated at the table and the engineer standing at the left
compositions.B: medium close-up of the engineer's relieved face with the wall clock showing 9:13 in the soft-focus background

scenes.title: DEATH PREDICTION  SUBJECT: YOU
scenes.beat_zh: 螢幕顯示 DEATH PREDICTION  SUBJECT: YOU。
scenes.action: Back at his desk the engineer sits stiffly in front of the monitor, his face pale with shock, reading the new message.
scenes.setting: the same modern home office, two monitors, bookshelf, window with city lights in the evening
scenes.lighting: cool monitor glow on his pale face, warm desk lamp, dusk light from the window, room details readable
scenes.on_screen_text: the monitor shows two lines of white text on a dark interface: "DEATH PREDICTION" and below it "SUBJECT: YOU"

compositions.A: medium shot from the side, the engineer at the right, the monitor with its two lines of text facing the camera at the left
compositions.B: over-the-shoulder shot from behind him, the screen's two lines of text sharp and large, his rigid shoulders and the back of his head in the foreground

scenes.title: 窗戶倒影中出現另一個自己
scenes.beat_zh: 男主看向窗戶。倒影中出現另一個自己。
scenes.action: The engineer turns his head toward the window and freezes. In the dark window glass his reflection shows a second identical man standing right behind him, although only one man is in the room.
scenes.setting: the same modern home office at night, a large window acting as a mirror, desk with monitors and a lamp
scenes.lighting: the lit room reflected clearly in the dark window glass, warm desk lamp and cool monitor glow, reflections and room details readable

compositions.A: medium shot from the side, the engineer at the left looking toward the window, the window glass at the right clearly showing the reflection of two men
compositions.B: close view of the window glass dominating the frame, the reflection of the engineer with an identical second man just behind his shoulder

scenes.video_note: Reflection tricks are likely to confuse the model; check which candidate reads as 'two people in the glass, one in the room'.

scenes.title: 不要回頭
scenes.beat_zh: AI：不要回頭。男主僵住。AI：你已經回頭過很多次了。
dialogue: AI：你已經回頭過很多次了。
scenes.action: The engineer sits frozen at his desk, staring straight ahead at the monitor, every muscle tense, sweat on his forehead, afraid to turn around.
scenes.setting: the same modern home office at night, desk with monitors, a dark window behind him
scenes.lighting: cool monitor glow on his face, warm desk lamp, a faint reflection of the room in the window, details readable
scenes.on_screen_text: the monitor shows a chat window with a single line of white text: "不要回頭"

compositions.A: medium shot from slightly behind and to the side, the engineer and the monitor with its single line of text, the dark window at the edge
compositions.B: tight close-up of his frozen face in profile lit by the screen, the monitor's text just readable beyond him
